subject: design/argus-attribution-hardening
statement: The fail-closed rule and the protected-path classification are carried forward from the superseded design unchanged in shape; the only change is that "underivable" is now the *absence of a positive signal* (Argus or human), not the absence of the Argus trailer alone *(design-brainstorm:argus-attribution-hardening-tech-design#D-3; basis FR-10, UB-4; AP-17)*.
